title: PAR-CLIP
scope: Hafner 2010 PAR-CLIP implementation, restricted to the 4SU-labeled cultured-cell route drawn in the assigned PAR-CLIP row and matching standalone schematic. The initial molecular icon is explanatory. Neighboring irCLIP/iCLIP rows and chemical legends are outside scope; 6SG mentioned in catalogue prose does not add an unshown route. The graph ends at physical cDNA, with subsequent sequencing and binding-site interpretation explained only as the readout interface. Immunopurification and its placement are resolved from the registered primary full text, without reconstructing routine library-preparation internals.

operations.label: Trim RNA with RNase T1 and isolate target RNPs
operations.description: Partially digest RNA and isolate target-RBP complexes carrying covalently bound RNA. This composite boundary retains the drawn RNase T1 action together with the immunopurification named in the assay title. Hafner 2010 resolves the implementation order: cell lysis and lysate RNase T1 treatment, anti-FLAG immunoprecipitation, further RNase T1 on the immunoprecipitate, then size fractionation and recovery before proteinase K. Routine internal manipulations are not expanded into graph nodes.
operations.mechanism: RNase T1 partially digests RNA; antibody-based isolation selects the tagged target RBP and attached RNA. Primary Figure 1C and Methods establish immunopurification and size fractionation before protein removal.
operations.information_effect: Retains RNA segments associated with the selected target protein, rather than representing all cellular transcripts. Antibody specificity and non-crosslinked background limit selectivity.

corrections.primary_statement: Registered Hafner 2010 full text names and describes PAR-CLIP and cites Hafner et al. 2008 specifically for conversion of recovered RNA into a cDNA library. The inspected 2008 abstract describes small-RNA library sequencing. The scoped assay association is therefore the 2010 PAR-CLIP paper; the 2008 paper is retained as library-preparation background. No invention date is inferred solely from either bibliographic record.

evidence.quote: Hafner M. et al. (2010) Cell 141: 129-141
Here we describe an improved method for isolation of segments of RNA bound by RBPs or RNPs, referred to as PAR-CLIP (Photoactivatable-Ribonucleoside-Enhanced Crosslinking and Immunoprecipitation).

evidence.locator: Literal reference entry on the PAR-CLIP catalogue card
evidence.quote: Par-CLIP: Hafner M., Landgraf P., Ludwig J., Rice A., Ojo T., et al. (2008) Identification of microRNAs and other small regulatory RNAs using cDNA library sequencing. Methods 44: 3-12
evidence.rationale: Literal secondary catalogue entry; the accompanying registered publication excerpt supplies the stated level of content assessment.

evidence.quote: Here we describe methods to prepare cDNA libraries from pools of small RNAs isolated from organisms, tissues or cells.
evidence.rationale: Only the registered abstract and bibliographic metadata were inspected for this 2008 paper. It describes small-RNA library sequencing, not the PAR-CLIP demonstration. The 2010 full text cites Hafner et al. 2008 for downstream library conversion; this component relationship does not make it a second target workflow or establish PAR-CLIP invention in 2008.

evidence.quote: The recovered RNA was turned into a cDNA library as described (Hafner et al., 2008) and Solexa sequenced.
evidence.rationale: Primary 2010 evidence establishes why the 2008 library-conversion protocol is related, without assigning it as the PAR-CLIP demonstration.
